```{r}
#laden der DMP csv Datei (CpG_overlap)
wd <- getwd()
data_path_2 <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/CpG_overlap.csv')
Top_ranking_CpGs <- read.csv(data_path_2)
```

```{r}
print(Top_ranking_CpGs)
```


```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
print(BRCA_methylation_data_original)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(umap)
```

```{r}
umap_results <- umap(BRCA_methylation_data_original, n_components = 2, n_neighbors = 15)
```

```{r}
# Convert umap_results to data frame
# Assuming umap_results is already computed as a numeric matrix
# Convert umap_results to a data frame (if not already)
umap_df <- as.data.frame(umap_results)
colnames(umap_df) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")  # Rename columns if necessary

# Add row names as a new column named 'CpG'
umap_df$CpG <- rownames(umap_df)

# Load ggplot2 library if not already loaded
library(ggplot2)

# Create ggplot visualization
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "UMAP Visualization of BRCA Methylation Data",
       x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("UMAP.pdf")
```

```{r}
umap_df$TopRanking <- ifelse(umap_df$CpG %in% Top_ranking_CpGs$Name, "Significant CpG", "Non significant CpG")

# Load ggplot2 library if not already loaded
library(ggplot2)

# Create ggplot visualization with color differentiation
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = TopRanking)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2", color = "CpG Significance") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant CpG" = "maroon", "Non significant CpG" = "black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8))
ggsave("UMAP_2.pdf")
```

methylation_Top_ranking_CpGs UMAP
```{r}
methylation_Top_ranking_CpGs <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[Top_ranking_CpGs$Name, ]

print(methylation_Top_ranking_CpGs)
```
